type:cutting-boards.h1: Personalized Cutting Boards, Engraved With Your Names
type:cutting-boards.meta: Personalized cutting boards cut from one solid slab of maple or walnut and laser engraved with your names, date or logo. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A personalized cutting board from our shop is one solid slab of maple or walnut, laser engraved with your names, a date, a family name or a company logo. Every board is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma and leaves the shop in 3-5 business days. Boards are the backbone of our shop, which has 46,000+ orders on Etsy.

Pick a size by how the board will be used. The 8x12 and 10x14 inch boards are 0.75 inch thick and handle daily chopping. The 12x16 inch board is 1.5 inches thick and sits heavy on a counter, and the 16x24 inch walnut board is a statement piece for a big kitchen or a serving table. Maple is light with a tight grain, so the engraving reads crisp and dark. Walnut is a deep brown that shows fewer knife marks.

Designs run from monograms like the Circle Monogram Family Name Cutting Board to the Home Sweet Home Names Cutting Board, our best-selling design, plus logo boards for businesses. If you are torn between the two woods, our maple vs. walnut guide walks through the tradeoffs.

faqs.q: How thick are your cutting boards?
faqs.a: The 8x12 and 10x14 inch boards are 0.75 inch thick. The 12x16 inch board and the 16x24 inch walnut board are 1.5 inches thick.

faqs.q: Is each board a single piece of wood?
faqs.a: Yes. Each board is one solid slab of maple or walnut.

faqs.q: What add-ons can I include with a board?
faqs.a: You can add a display stand, conditioning oil, a handwritten card or paper gift wrap when you order.

faqs.q: Will I see the design before it is engraved?
faqs.a: Yes. We email a free digital proof, and we engrave only after you approve it.

type:charcuterie-boards.meta: Personalized charcuterie and cheese boards in maple or walnut, engraved near one end so the spread fits around your names. Made to order in Pryor, OK.
intro: Our personalized charcuterie boards are solid maple or walnut serving boards with the engraving set toward one end or corner, so cheese, meat and crackers fit around it instead of covering it. Each one is laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, ready to ship in 3-5 business days.

The layout is the difference from our cutting boards. On the Circle Monogram Charcuterie Board the ring sits off to one side, and on the Last Name Cheese Board and the Names and Date Serving Tray the names run along one end. That leaves a clear field for a spread, and the names still show when the board is set out for guests.

For a host who feeds a crowd, the 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick carries a full spread, and the 16x24 inch walnut board covers a buffet end to end. The 8x12 and 10x14 inch sizes suit a cheese night for two. Walnut gives food a warm, dark backdrop; maple makes the engraving pop. Add a display stand and the board can live on the counter between parties.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a charcuterie board and a cutting board here?
faqs.a: The wood and sizes are the same. On serving designs we place the engraving near one end or a corner so food can sit on the open wood.

faqs.q: What size serving board holds a party spread?
faqs.a: The 12x16 inch board or the 16x24 inch walnut board. The 8x12 and 10x14 inch boards suit a smaller spread.

faqs.q: Can the board stay on display when it is not in use?
faqs.a: Yes. Add a display stand at checkout and the board stands upright on a counter or shelf.

type:coasters.meta: Personalized wood coasters in maple or walnut, engraved with your names, initial or date, in sets of 2, 4, 8 or 16. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized wood coasters are maple or walnut, laser engraved with your names, initial, last name or date on every coaster in the set. We make them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, in sets of 2, 4, 8 or 16, and they ship in 3-5 business days.

Most of our coaster designs are the same layouts we engrave on boards, sized down: the Circle Monogram Wood Coasters, the Laurel Wreath Family Name Coasters with 'The [Last Name]s' inside a wreath, and the Home State Names Coasters with your state in place of the O. Because the design repeats on each piece, a set reads as one family name spread across a coffee table.

A set of 4 covers a couple or a small living room. Sets of 8 or 16 make sense for a big family, a bar cart, or splitting between two households. If you want the full look, add a matching small or medium board to the order so both carry the same engraving. Coaster sets start from $16.50.

faqs.q: How many coasters come in a set?
faqs.a: You choose 2, 4, 8 or 16. Every coaster in the set gets the same engraving.

faqs.q: Can I get a board that matches my coasters?
faqs.a: Yes. A matching small or medium board can be added to a coaster order, engraved with the same design.

faqs.q: Is the design printed or engraved?
faqs.a: Engraved. The laser burns the design into the maple or walnut, so there is no ink or sticker to peel off.

type:wine-glasses.meta: Engraved 21 oz stemless wine glasses with your monogram or a funny saying, single or in sets of 2, 4 or 8. Laser etched to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our engraved wine glasses are 21 oz stemless glasses with the design laser etched into the glass, from monograms with your names to the one-liners people actually laugh at. They are made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma and ship in 3-5 business days, as a single glass or a set of 2, 4 or 8.

The collection splits two ways. Wedding and couples glasses, like the Monogram Last Name Wedding Wine Glass and the Couples Circle Monogram Wine Glasses, carry your names and date and are often ordered as a pair for a toast. The funny glasses carry a saying: My Favorite Child Gave Me This Glass, Dad, The Man, The Myth, The Legend, and designs for engineers, teachers and nurses.

Stemless glasses sit low and are hard to knock over, which is why they work at a backyard party or a bachelorette weekend. For a bridal party, order the Bridesmaid Name Wine Glass once per person with each name typed in. A glass also pairs with a board for a two-part gift; see our cutting boards.

faqs.q: How big are the glasses?
faqs.a: Each one is a 21 oz stemless wine glass, roomy enough for a full pour with space to swirl.

faqs.q: Can every glass in a set carry a different name?
faqs.a: Sets of 2, 4 or 8 are best when every glass carries the same design. For different names, order each glass on its own with its own name.

faqs.q: Will the engraving wash off?
faqs.a: No. The laser etches the design into the surface of the glass itself, so there is no ink or vinyl to wear away.

type:ornaments.meta: Personalized wood ornaments laser engraved with names, a year, a saying or your logo. Single or sets of 2, 5 or 10, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized wood ornaments are laser engraved with names, a year, a saying or a logo, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days. You can order a single ornament or a set of 2, 5 or 10.

The shapes and designs cover most of the tree. Our First Christmas Together is for a couple's first year, with string lights over your names. This Is Us fits a whole family's first names and the year. The Pet Paw Name Ornament holds a pet's name in the pad, the Teacher Pencil Ornament carries a teacher's name and school year, and the Heaven in Our Home ornament remembers someone with a name and their years.

Sets are where ornaments get practical. A set of 5 or 10 covers grandkids, neighbors or a team, and the Custom Logo Ornament is the one businesses send to clients each December. Because every piece is engraved to order, start a long list in the fall; if the date is close, ask us about rush.

faqs.q: How many ornaments can I order at once?
faqs.a: Ornaments come single or in sets of 2, 5 or 10. For more than that, ask us about larger orders.

faqs.q: Is there an ornament for someone who has passed?
faqs.a: Yes. The Heaven in Our Home Memorial Ornament is a heart with an angel wing and the line 'Because someone we love is in heaven,' engraved with a name and years.

faqs.q: Do you make ornaments for teachers?
faqs.a: Yes. The Teacher Pencil Ornament is shaped like a pencil and carries the teacher's name, who it is from and the school year.

type:guest-books.meta: Wedding guest book alternatives: wood signature signs engraved with your names and date, sized for 30 to 250 guests. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our wedding guest book alternatives are wood signs your guests sign at the reception, engraved with your last name, first names and wedding date. We make each one to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days, and after the wedding it hangs on a wall instead of sitting in a drawer.

There are two styles. The 3D Last Name Guest Book Sign has your last name laser cut and raised in the center of a signature frame, and the Mr and Mrs version adds a small 'Mr & Mrs' above it. The round signs put your last name in script in the middle of a circle, with open wood around it for signatures.

Size it by guest count: 20 in for 30-45 guests, 24 in for 45-55, 27.5 in for 55-70, 30 in for 65-85, 36 in for 90-110, 42 in for 125-175 and 48 in for 200-250. Finishes are natural, stained, painted black or painted white. More ideas are in our guest book alternatives guide.

faqs.q: What size guest book sign do I need?
faqs.a: Match it to your guest count. The 20 in sign holds 30-45 guests and the 48 in sign holds 200-250, with five sizes in between.

faqs.q: What finishes are available?
faqs.a: Natural, stained, painted black or painted white.

faqs.q: What should guests sign with?
faqs.a: A fine-tip permanent marker works on the natural, stained and white finishes. On painted black, a metallic or white paint pen shows up better. Test your pen on the back first.

faqs.q: Is the 3D last name raised off the frame?
faqs.a: Yes. On the 3D designs your last name is laser cut and raised in the center of the frame, so guests sign around it.

occasion:wedding-gifts.meta: Personalized wedding gifts engraved with the couple's names and date: boards, coasters, wine glasses and guest book signs, made to order in Pryor, OK.
intro: Our personalized wedding gifts are engraved with the couple's names and wedding date: cutting boards, serving boards, coasters, stemless wine glasses and guest book signs. Everything is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma and ships in 3-5 business days, with a free digital proof before we engrave.

If you are a guest buying off the registry, a board with the couple's names gets used long after the wedding. The Circle Monogram Family Name Cutting Board puts first names on top, the last-name initial in the middle and the date below; the Classic Last Name and Date Cutting Board is simpler. Confirm the spelling of the married name and the exact date with someone close to the couple before you order.

If you are the couple, look at the reception side: a guest book sign sized to your guest list, a pair of monogram wine glasses for the toast, and the Mr and Mrs Script Cake Topper. See what to engrave on a cutting board for wording ideas.

faqs.q: Should a wedding board use the couple's new last name?
faqs.a: Only if you know they are taking it. If you are not sure, first names and the wedding date are a safe layout, like the Script Names and Year Cutting Board.

faqs.q: Is it all right to send a wedding gift after the wedding?
faqs.a: Yes. Etiquette generally allows a gift within a few months of the wedding, so a made-to-order piece that arrives after the day is fine.

faqs.q: Can I include a note with the gift?
faqs.a: Yes. Add a handwritten card to a board order and include the message you want on it.

faqs.q: Do you make a wedding cake topper?
faqs.a: Yes. The Mr and Mrs Script Cake Topper is a laser-cut 'Mr & Mrs' in script, from $42.55.

occasion:anniversary-gifts.meta: Personalized anniversary gifts engraved with your names and wedding date on maple or walnut boards, coasters and wine glasses. Made to order in Pryor, OK.
intro: Our personalized anniversary gifts carry your names and wedding date, engraved on solid maple or walnut boards, coasters and 21 oz stemless wine glasses. They are made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, and each one ships in 3-5 business days.

The date is what makes an anniversary piece different from a wedding piece. Designs like the Bold Last Name Anniversary Cutting Board and the Circle Monogram Anniversary Cutting Board give the wedding date a prominent spot, so the board reads as married since, not just married. If you want to match the material to the year, our anniversary gifts by year guide lists the traditional material for each one.

Anniversaries have a fixed date, so count back from it: 3-5 business days to make the piece, plus shipping time. When the date is tight, ask us about rush. If you are buying for a couple rather than your spouse, the Couples Circle Monogram Wine Glasses can be ordered as a pair, one for each of them.

faqs.q: What is the difference between your wedding boards and anniversary boards?
faqs.a: The wood and sizes are the same. Anniversary layouts give the wedding date more room, so the board reads as years together.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I order an anniversary gift?
faqs.a: Each piece takes 3-5 business days to make before it ships, so ordering a couple of weeks ahead is comfortable. Ask us about rush if the date is closer.

faqs.q: What should I engrave on an anniversary gift for my spouse?
faqs.a: Your first names, your last name and your wedding date are the core. Many couples add 'Est.' before the year.

faqs.q: Do you have anniversary gifts that are not boards?
faqs.a: Yes. Coaster sets, stemless wine glasses and the Our First Christmas Together ornament are all in this collection.

occasion:5th-anniversary-wood-gifts.meta: Wood is the traditional 5th anniversary gift. Maple and walnut boards, coasters and ornaments engraved with your names and wedding date, made in Pryor, OK.
intro: Wood is the traditional 5th-anniversary gift. We engrave solid maple and walnut boards, coasters and ornaments with your names and wedding date, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

Five years in, most couples own the kitchen basics, so a board they would not buy for themselves lands well. A 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick, or the 16x24 inch walnut board, feels like a step up from an everyday board. Walnut is dark brown and hides knife marks; maple is light and shows the engraving in sharp contrast. Either way, the wood itself is the theme.

Lists vary by source. On the traditional list wood is the 5th; on the common modern list wood shows up at year six, so a wood gift works for either. Put the wedding date on it, not the date you give it. For more ideas by type and budget, read our 5th-anniversary gift guide.

faqs.q: Is wood really the 5th-anniversary gift?
faqs.a: On the traditional list, yes. The common modern list puts wood at the 6th year instead, and lists vary by source.

faqs.q: What is a good 5 year anniversary gift for him?
faqs.a: A thick 12x16 inch walnut board with your names and wedding date suits someone who cooks or grills. Add conditioning oil so he can keep it in shape.

faqs.q: What is a good 5 year anniversary gift for her?
faqs.a: A monogram serving board, or a set of coasters that matches a board you already own, puts your date somewhere she sees it every day.

faqs.q: Are coasters or ornaments enough for a wood anniversary?
faqs.a: Yes, both are wood and both carry your names and date. They are a lighter gift than a board and pair well with a card.

occasion:engagement-gifts.h1: Personalized Engagement Gifts for the Couple
occasion:engagement-gifts.meta: Personalized engagement gifts: maple or walnut boards engraved with the couple's names and engagement or wedding date. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized engagement gifts are solid maple or walnut boards engraved with the couple's names and their wedding date or engagement date. We make them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, and each board ships out in 3-5 business days.

An engagement gift has one catch: the wedding date may not be set yet. The Script Names, Last Name and Date Board and the Bold Last Name Couples Cutting Board both work with the engagement date in the date line, so you can give it at the party without waiting on the save-the-date. If they have picked a day, the Initial and Last Name Engagement Board frames it in the center.

Last names are the other catch. Ask before you engrave a shared last name, or skip it and use first names only. Engagement gifts tend to be smaller than wedding gifts, so the 8x12 or 10x14 inch board, 0.75 inch thick, is a sensible size. The Mr and Mrs Last Name Board is the one to save for a couple who has already said they will share a name.

faqs.q: What date goes on an engagement gift?
faqs.a: Use the proposal date, or the wedding date if it is set. Both fit the date line on our designs.

faqs.q: What if I don't know whether they will share a last name?
faqs.a: Use first names and a date only, or quietly ask someone close to the couple before you order.

faqs.q: Is a board too much for an engagement party?
faqs.a: Not at our smaller sizes. Boards start from $29.70 and read as thoughtful rather than extravagant.

occasion:bridal-shower-gifts.h1: Bridal Shower Gifts for the Bride
occasion:bridal-shower-gifts.seo_title: Bridal Shower Gifts for the Bride
occasion:bridal-shower-gifts.meta: Bridal shower gifts for the bride: maple or walnut boards engraved with the couple's names and wedding date. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our bridal shower gifts are engraved boards for the bride-to-be and her partner, with their names and wedding date on solid maple or walnut. We engrave each board to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, and it ships in 3-5 business days.

Shower gifts get opened in front of a room, so the design should read from across it. The Mr and Mrs Last Name Board puts 'mr & mrs' in script over the new last name and date, and the Filigree Last Name Newlywed Board sets the last name in large capitals between two borders. The Circle Monogram Bridal Shower Board is the more classic option, with names and date inside a ring.

Showers usually come weeks before the wedding, so the date on the board is the wedding date, not the shower date. If the shower has a kitchen theme, a board fits it directly. Paper gift wrap and a handwritten card are available as add-ons if it is shipping straight to the host.

faqs.q: Can I ship a shower gift straight to the host?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter the host's address at checkout and add paper gift wrap if you want it wrapped.

faqs.q: Is an engraved board a good shower gift if she has a registry?
faqs.a: Yes. Personalized pieces rarely appear on registries, so an engraved board sits alongside registry gifts instead of duplicating one.

faqs.q: How early should I order a bridal shower gift?
faqs.a: Order when the invitation arrives. Each board takes 3-5 business days to make before it ships.

occasion:housewarming-gifts.meta: Personalized housewarming gifts: boards and coasters engraved with names, year, state or street address for a new home. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized housewarming gifts are engraved boards and coasters for a new home, with the family's names, the year they moved in, their state or even the address. Every piece is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma and ships in 3-5 business days.

The home-themed designs are built for this: the Home Sweet Home Names Cutting Board (our best-selling design), the Welcome Home Address Cutting Board with the street address, the Home Sweet Home Coordinates Board with the GPS coordinates of the house, and the Home State Names Cutting Board with the state in place of the O. For a couple's first home, the New Home, New Adventures Key Cutting Board has two skeleton keys and their names.

Get the address or coordinates right: copy them from the listing or a map pin, not from memory. A housewarming party means guests in the kitchen, so a serving board or a set of coasters gets used the first night. Our gifts for new homeowners page groups the pieces by who is moving.

faqs.q: Can you engrave the house's coordinates?
faqs.a: Yes. The Home Sweet Home Coordinates Board engraves the GPS coordinates of the house under Home Sweet Home in script.

faqs.q: What year goes on a housewarming board?
faqs.a: The year they moved in or bought the house. Some families use the year they married instead.

faqs.q: Should I bring a gift to a housewarming party?
faqs.a: It is customary to bring something. A set of coasters, from $16.50, fits a casual party, and a board suits a closer friend or family member.

occasion:realtor-closing-gifts.meta: Realtor closing gifts: engraved cutting boards with the buyers' names, year and your name or logo small in the corner. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A realtor closing gift is the thank-you an agent gives buyers at or after closing, and our engraved cutting boards are built for it: the buyers' names, the year, and your name or logo small in the corner. We make each one to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, in 3-5 business days.

What to give depends on the buyers. First-time buyers get a lot out of the New Home, New Adventures Key Cutting Board. Families who spent months looking tend to like the Home Sweet Home Coordinates Board, which carries the exact location of the house. If you want your name on it without turning it into an ad, the Home Sweet Home Board with Agent Signature adds a small 'Compliments of' line, and the Realtor Signature Corner Board keeps your name and number tucked in the corner.

Order when the home goes under contract, not at closing, and pull names from the purchase agreement so the spelling matches. Our closing gift guide covers etiquette, and agents who give closing gifts on every deal can use Forever Client Gifts, our dedicated realtor closing-gift site.

faqs.q: Should my logo go on a closing gift?
faqs.a: Keep it small. A corner logo or a 'Compliments of' line reminds buyers who helped them without making the board feel like marketing.

faqs.q: When should I give a closing gift?
faqs.a: At the closing table or at the key handoff. Ordering once the home is under contract leaves time to make and ship it.

faqs.q: Can the board ship directly to the buyers' new address?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter their new address at checkout, and add a handwritten card so they know who sent it.

faqs.q: Which closing board works for first-time buyers?
faqs.a: The New Home, New Adventures Key Cutting Board, with a pair of skeleton keys and their names, suits a first home.

occasion:corporate-gifts.h1: Corporate and Client Gifts Engraved With Your Logo
occasion:corporate-gifts.meta: Corporate and client gifts: maple and walnut cutting boards and wood ornaments laser engraved with your company logo. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our corporate gifts are solid maple and walnut cutting boards and wood ornaments laser engraved with your company logo. Upload your logo file when you order; we make each piece in Pryor, Oklahoma and ship it in 3-5 business days.

Choose the logo placement by who gets the gift. A client who should use it at home gets the Corner Logo Client Gift Board, with the logo small in one corner of walnut. A board meant for the break room or a trade-show table can take the Full Logo Cutting Board, engraved edge to edge. The Custom Logo Ornament is the lighter option for a holiday mailing.

Send the cleanest logo file you have, ideally a vector or a high-resolution image with a transparent background. The laser engraves in one tone, so a one-color version of your logo reads most crisply on wood. Plan year-end gifts early, and for a long list ask us about larger orders. Our corporate gift guide covers timing and wording.

faqs.q: What logo file should I upload?
faqs.a: A vector file or a high-resolution image with a transparent background works best. Colors and gradients become a single tone when engraved.

faqs.q: Do you offer pricing for large corporate orders?
faqs.a: Ask us about larger orders and we will talk through what you need.

faqs.q: Is a logo on a client gift too promotional?
faqs.a: It can be, which is why several of our logo designs keep it small in a corner. The client sees who sent it without feeling advertised to.

faqs.q: What is a lower-cost corporate gift for a long client list?
faqs.a: The Custom Logo Ornament. It carries your logo on a round wood ornament and comes single or in sets of 2, 5 or 10.

occasion:employee-appreciation-gifts.meta: Employee appreciation and years-of-service gifts: logo cutting boards and ornaments, with names and years if you want. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our employee appreciation gifts are engraved wood boards and ornaments that carry your company logo, and in some designs the employee's name and years of service. They are made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, with 3-5 business days to engrave before they ship.

For a milestone, the Years of Service Appreciation Board has room for your company name, the employee's name, a line of thanks and their years with you. That makes it fit a work anniversary or a retirement send-off from the team. For a whole-staff thank-you, the Employee Appreciation Logo Board and the Custom Logo Ornament keep the design identical across everyone, which keeps a large order simple.

A gift an employee takes home to the kitchen is seen by their family too, which a desk item is not. Collect names in one spreadsheet and have someone check spellings before you order, and ask us about larger orders if you are covering a full team.

faqs.q: What do I engrave on a years of service gift?
faqs.a: The employee's name, the number of years, a short line of thanks and your company name. Keep the thanks to one sentence so it stays readable.

faqs.q: Is a cutting board a good retirement gift for a coworker?
faqs.a: It is practical and personal. The Years of Service Appreciation Board holds their name and years, so it reads as a thank-you rather than a generic present.

faqs.q: Can each employee's board carry a different name?
faqs.a: Yes. Each board is engraved to order, so order one per person with that person's name. For a long list, ask us about larger orders.

occasion:christmas-gifts.meta: Personalized Christmas gifts: engraved wood ornaments, funny wine glasses and family recipe boards, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized Christmas gifts are engraved wood ornaments, stemless wine glasses and cutting boards, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma. Each one is engraved in 3-5 business days, so plan around the holiday mail.

Ornaments carry most of the season. Our First Christmas Together marks a couple's first year, the Deer Family First Christmas Ornament marks a new title like mom or grandma, and It's Always Christmas at Grandma and Grandpa's House is the one grandkids give. For a hostess gift, the Festive AF Holiday Wine Glass or the Will Wrap for Wine Glass goes in a bag with a bottle. The Family Recipe Cutting Board, with a family recipe engraved in script, is the bigger gift under the tree.

Holiday mail runs slower in December, so the most useful tip is to order in November. If you are buying for a whole list, sets of 5 or 10 ornaments cover teachers, neighbors and coworkers in one order.

faqs.q: What is a good Christmas hostess gift?
faqs.a: A funny stemless wine glass, such as Festive AF, handed over with a bottle of wine. It is small, useful and personal.

faqs.q: Do you make a first Christmas ornament?
faqs.a: Yes. Our First Christmas Together is for couples, and the Deer Family First Christmas Ornament is for a new mom, grandma or other new title, with the year.

faqs.q: How late can I order for Christmas?
faqs.a: Count back from Christmas: 3-5 business days to make it, plus shipping time, which runs longer in December. If you are close, ask us about rush.

occasion:mothers-day-gifts.meta: Personalized Mother's Day gifts: funny engraved wine glasses, family recipe boards and birth flower boards for mom. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our Mother's Day gifts are engraved stemless wine glasses with sayings moms laugh at, and cutting boards that carry her children's names or a family recipe. Each is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, with 3-5 business days to make it.

The glasses are the lighthearted end: My Favorite Child Gave Me This Glass, Mom, At Least You Don't Have Ugly Children, and Mom, Sorry You Had to Raise My Sibling, signed 'your favorite.' The sentimental end is the Mom's Kitchen Birth Flower Board, with a birth flower, name and year for each child, and the Family Recipe Cutting Board, which engraves one of her recipes in script with a title and sign-off.

For a recipe board, type the recipe exactly as it is written on her card, including how she signs it, and keep it short enough to read at a glance. Mother's Day falls in May, a busy month for gifts, so order in April if you can. A glass and a board together cover both the laugh and the sentiment.

faqs.q: Can you engrave my mom's recipe?
faqs.a: Yes. The Family Recipe Cutting Board engraves the recipe text in a script font with a title and sign-off. Type it exactly as she wrote it, measurements and all.

faqs.q: What goes on the Mom's Kitchen Birth Flower Board?
faqs.a: 'Everything is better in Mom's Kitchen,' with a birth flower, a name and a year for each child.

faqs.q: Is a funny wine glass enough for Mother's Day?
faqs.a: For a mom with a sense of humor, yes. The glasses start from $15.81 and pair well with a bottle or a board.

occasion:fathers-day-gifts.meta: Father's Day gifts for dad: the Grillfather cutting board, a veteran flag board and engraved wine glasses with sayings. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our Father's Day gifts are engraved cutting boards for the dad who runs the grill and stemless wine glasses with sayings he will actually use. Everything is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, taking 3-5 business days before it ships.

The Grillfather Cutting Board is the grill-side pick: heavy lettering and a steaming sausage for the one who runs the smoker. For a veteran, the Veteran Flag Cutting Board has a distressed vertical flag, 'VETERAN' down one side and a branch emblem at the top. The glasses cover the rest: Dad, The Man, The Myth, The Legend, plus two engineer glasses for the dad who explains how everything works.

For grilling, pick the 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick or the 16x24 inch walnut board; both give room to rest and carve meat. Walnut is darker and shows fewer barbecue stains than maple. Add conditioning oil, since a grill board gets washed often and dries out faster.

faqs.q: What board size suits a grill master?
faqs.a: Go bigger: the 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick, or the 16x24 inch walnut board for large cuts like brisket.

faqs.q: Is there a Father's Day gift for a dad who served?
faqs.a: Yes. The Veteran Flag Cutting Board has 'VETERAN' down one side of a distressed flag with a branch emblem at the top.

faqs.q: When should I order for Father's Day?
faqs.a: Father's Day is the third Sunday in June in the US. Order by early June to allow 3-5 business days of making plus shipping.

occasion:family-keepsakes.meta: Family name boards, recipe cutting boards, family ornaments and signature signs, laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.
intro: Our family keepsakes are engraved family name boards, recipe cutting boards, family ornaments and signature signs, made for the kitchen and the tree rather than a shelf. We make them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

The recipe cutting board is the most personal piece here. Our Family Recipe Cutting Board lays out a family recipe in script with a title and a sign-off, so grandma's pie crust or dad's chili lives on the counter instead of on a stained index card. The Established Family Name Charcuterie Board puts 'The [Last Name]s' and an established year on a serving board, and the This Is Us ornaments list every family member's first name.

For a recipe, shorter is better: pick one with a short ingredient list and trim the steps to the essentials. For a family name board, decide on the year first. Many families use the wedding year; blended families sometimes use the year they became one household.

faqs.q: How long can a recipe be on a recipe board?
faqs.a: Keep it to a short ingredient list and a few steps so the text stays large enough to read. If it runs long, you will see that on the proof before anything is engraved.

faqs.q: What year goes on an established family name board?
faqs.a: Whatever year your family counts from: the wedding year, the year you moved in, or the year the family came together.

faqs.q: Do you make family pieces that hang on a wall?
faqs.a: Yes. The round last-name signs and the signature frame carry your family name and year and hang on a wall. They start as wedding guest books but work for any family gathering.

occasion:bachelorette-bridesmaid-gifts.meta: Bridesmaid and bachelorette gifts: 21 oz stemless wine glasses engraved with her name, role and wedding date. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our bridesmaid and bachelorette gifts are 21 oz stemless wine glasses engraved with each woman's name, her role and the wedding date, or with a saying for the party. Each glass is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, with 3-5 business days to engrave.

The Bridesmaid Name Wine Glass is the core of this page. It carries 'Bridesmaid' or any other role, her name in large script and the wedding date, so the whole party matches while every glass is still hers. For the bride, the Last Name Wedding Wine Glass puts her soon-to-be last name in large capitals with first names in script. Give Me Wine and Tell Me I'm Pretty is a lighter pick for the weekend itself.

Order once per person so each name is right, and gather the full list with spellings before you check out. Stemless glasses travel well in a weekend bag and are harder to tip over on a crowded hotel counter than a tall stem.

faqs.q: Can the glass say maid of honor instead of bridesmaid?
faqs.a: Yes. The role line takes any title, such as maid of honor, matron of honor or bride.

faqs.q: Do you engrave the wedding date on bridesmaid glasses?
faqs.a: Yes. The date goes under her name, which keeps the glass tied to the wedding after the weekend is over.

faqs.q: When should I hand out bridesmaid glasses?
faqs.a: Many brides give them at the bachelorette party or the morning of the wedding, when everyone is getting ready together.

occasion:birthday-gifts.meta: Funny wine glass birthday gifts and personalized boards: 21 oz stemless glasses with sayings or a name, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our birthday gifts are mostly engraved stemless wine glasses with a saying, plus a few cutting boards, all made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days. A 21 oz glass with the right line on it starts from $15.81.

Match the saying to the person. You're My Favorite Cardio and I Do Yoga to Relax suit the friend who jokes about the gym. Girl Boss Building Her Empire and I Make Money Moves are for the one running a side business. Started From the Bottle, Now I'm Here fits a milestone birthday with a sense of humor, and Trust Me, I'm an Engineer speaks for itself.

If you want a name on it, the Initial and Name Wine Glass has one tall initial with a first name in script across it. For a bigger birthday, The Grillfather Cutting Board or the Mom's Kitchen Birth Flower Board goes further. A single glass fits in a gift bag next to a bottle of their usual wine.

faqs.q: Can I get a birthday glass with just a name?
faqs.a: Yes. The Initial and Name Wine Glass carries one tall initial with a name in script across it.

faqs.q: Are the funny glasses appropriate for a coworker?
faqs.a: Most are office-safe. A few, like Festive AF, use stronger language, so read the full saying before you order for work.

faqs.q: Can I order a birthday glass for a group of friends?
faqs.a: Yes. Each glass comes single or in a set of 2, 4 or 8, which works for friends celebrating together.

occasion:graduation-gifts.meta: Funny graduation gifts for engineers, nurses and new professionals: engraved 21 oz stemless wine glasses, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our graduation gifts are 21 oz stemless wine glasses engraved with a line for the grad's field or attitude, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days. They are meant for college and grad school graduates of legal drinking age.

Engineering grads get two choices: Trust Me, I'm an Engineer, wrapped in rows of binary, and I'm an Engineer, I'm Good With Math, which misspells the word three times before the punchline. Nursing grads get Nurse Life, with a stethoscope drawn around the script. For business majors, Girl Boss and I Make Money Moves fit, and Wine, Because Adulting Is Hard is honest about the first job.
A glass is a light gift to hand over at a graduation party, and it sits easily next to a card with a check in it. Order once the ceremony date is confirmed and give yourself about two weeks.

faqs.q: What is a good gift for an engineering graduate?
faqs.a: Either engineer glass. Trust Me, I'm an Engineer is the straight joke; I'm Good With Math is the self-deprecating one.

faqs.q: Do you have a gift for a nursing school graduate?
faqs.a: Yes. The Nurse Life Wine Glass has 'Nurse life' in script with a stethoscope drawn around it.

faqs.q: Are these glasses right for a high school graduate?
faqs.a: No, they are meant for graduates of legal drinking age. For a younger grad, look at our cutting boards instead.

recipient:couples.meta: Personalized gifts for couples: boards, coasters, wine glasses and ornaments engraved with two names and a date. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized gifts for couples carry two first names, a shared last name and a date: boards and coasters in maple or walnut, stemless wine glasses and ornaments. Everything is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

The layout matters more than the occasion. Couples who share a last name suit the monogram designs, like the Circle Monogram Family Name Cutting Board or the Laurel Wreath Family Name Coasters. Couples with two last names, or who have not decided, do better with first-name layouts like the Script Names and Year Cutting Board, which runs both names in one line of script with a small 'est.' year.

Gifts that come in pairs make sense for two people: the Couples Circle Monogram Wine Glasses are one for each of them. For a bigger gift, the Circle Monogram Board and Coaster Gift Set engraves a board and coasters with the same design, from $46.20. Whatever the design, the date can be the day they met, married or moved in together.

faqs.q: What if the couple has two different last names?
faqs.a: Use a first-names layout. The Script Names and Year Cutting Board avoids last names entirely.

faqs.q: Do you have a matching set for a couple?
faqs.a: Yes. The Circle Monogram Board and Coaster Gift Set pairs a board with coasters engraved to match.

faqs.q: What date should go on a gift for a couple who isn't married?
faqs.a: The date they met, got engaged or moved in together. Any date fits the date line.

recipient:her.meta: Personalized gifts for her: funny engraved wine glasses, recipe boards and family ornaments for moms, wives, friends and brides. Made in Pryor, OK.
intro: Our personalized gifts for her range from engraved stemless wine glasses with a saying she will repeat to boards and ornaments with her name, her family or her recipe. All of it is laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, with 3-5 business days before it ships.

Start with who she is to you. For a mom or grandma, the Family Recipe Cutting Board and the Mom's Kitchen Birth Flower Board carry family details. For a friend, the glasses do the talking: Sip Happens, I'm On Cloud Wine, Girl Boss Building Her Empire. For a bride or a new wife, the Mr and Mrs Last Name Board and the Diagonal Monogram Anniversary Board mark the wedding. For a nurse, there is the Nurse Life Wine Glass.
When you are torn between funny and sentimental, pair them. A glass from $15.81 with an 8x12 inch board covers both, and paper gift wrap and a handwritten card can be added to the board.

faqs.q: What is a good small gift for her?
faqs.a: Any of our engraved wine glasses, from $15.81, or a coaster set, from $16.50.

faqs.q: Can I put her name on a wine glass?
faqs.a: Yes. The Initial and Name Wine Glass has her initial with her name in script, and the Bridesmaid Name Wine Glass carries a name, a role and a date.

faqs.q: What is a thoughtful gift for a mom who cooks?
faqs.a: The Family Recipe Cutting Board with one of her own recipes, or the Mom's Kitchen Birth Flower Board with each child's birth flower.

recipient:him.meta: Personalized gifts for him: thick walnut cutting boards for grilling and engraved stemless glasses with dry humor. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized gifts for him are engraved cutting boards for grilling and stemless glasses with a dry sense of humor, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days. They work for husbands, brothers, engineers and veterans as well as dads.

A 1.5 in walnut board is the version most people would not buy for themselves. A 1.5 inch thick walnut board is the nice version: heavy, dark, and big enough at 16x24 inches to carve a brisket on. Walnut also shows fewer knife marks than maple, which suits a board that will get used hard. The Grillfather Cutting Board and the Veteran Flag Cutting Board are ready-made designs if you do not want to write your own.

For a lighter gift, the Initial and Name Wine Glass puts one tall initial and his name on a 21 oz stemless glass, and it holds whiskey or iced tea as well as wine. For a husband at year five, see wood anniversary gifts, since wood is the traditional 5th.

faqs.q: What do you get a man who has everything?
faqs.a: Something he would not buy himself, like a 1.5 inch thick walnut board engraved with his name or your names.

faqs.q: Is a wine glass a good gift for a man who doesn't drink wine?
faqs.a: Yes. A 21 oz stemless glass holds beer, whiskey or water just as well, and the engraving is the point.

faqs.q: Walnut or maple for a gift for him?
faqs.a: Walnut if he wants dark wood that hides wear; maple if he wants the engraving to stand out in sharp contrast.

recipient:realtors.h1: Closing Gifts for Realtors Who Give Them on Every Deal
recipient:realtors.seo_title: Gifts for Realtors to Give Clients
recipient:realtors.meta: For agents who give closing gifts on every deal: engraved boards, coasters and logo ornaments with buyers' names and your brand. Made in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: This page is for real estate agents who send closing gifts on every deal. We engrave cutting boards, coasters and ornaments with your buyers' names and your name or logo, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

If you close a few homes a month, pick two or three designs and make them your standard, so each buyer gets something consistent with your brand. One setup that works: the Home Sweet Home Realtor Closing Board for most buyers, the Home Sweet Home Coordinates Board for a house they fought for, and the Custom Logo Ornament mailed to past clients each December so your name stays in front of them.

Keep your brokerage logo file and your "Compliments of" wording saved in one place so every order goes in the same way. For a site built around this, visit foreverclientgifts.com, our dedicated realtor closing-gift site, or read our page for realtors.

faqs.q: Can I order for several closings at once?
faqs.a: Yes. Add each board as its own item with that buyer's names. For steady volume, ask us about larger orders.

faqs.q: What can I send past clients to stay in touch?
faqs.a: The Custom Logo Ornament each holiday season is a modest way to stay in touch. A set of Home State Names Coasters works for a one-year home anniversary.

faqs.q: Do you have a separate site for realtors?
faqs.a: Yes. Forever Client Gifts is our realtor closing-gift site, run by the same shop.

faqs.q: Can a closing board show my name without my logo?
faqs.a: Yes. The Home Sweet Home Board with Agent Signature uses a small 'Compliments of' line with your name instead of a logo.

recipient:businesses.meta: For companies that give every year: logo boards and ornaments for clients, staff milestones and partners, laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: This page is for companies that give gifts every year: to clients at the holidays, to staff on work anniversaries, to partners after a big project. We laser engrave your logo on solid wood boards and ornaments in Pryor, Oklahoma, and each order is made in 3-5 business days.

A simple way to handle this is a small gift program instead of a scramble each December. Choose one board for top clients, such as the Corner Logo Cutting Board in walnut, one for employee milestones, such as the Years of Service Appreciation Board, and the Custom Logo Ornament as the budget piece for a wide list. Using the same logo file and placement every year makes the gifts look like a set.

Name one person as the contact for proofs so approvals do not stall, and send the recipient list with spellings in one file. For larger or repeat orders, use our business inquiry page and we will work through quantities and timing with you.

faqs.q: Who approves the proof on a company order?
faqs.a: Whoever you name as the contact. We email the proof to that person and engrave once they approve.

faqs.q: Can we reorder the same design next year?
faqs.a: Yes. Keep your logo file and note the design and placement, and order the same one so the gifts match year to year.

faqs.q: How should a first company order start?
faqs.a: Pick a design, upload your logo and review the proof. For a long list, reach out through our business page first so we can plan the order together.

recipient:new-homeowners.meta: Gifts for new homeowners: engraved boards and coaster sets with their names, family name or a welcome-home design. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our gifts for new homeowners are engraved boards and coaster sets with the owners' names, their family name or a welcome-home design, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days. They suit first-time buyers, couples and families settling into a new place.

Think about what the house is missing. A move from an apartment to a house usually means a bigger kitchen and bare tables, so coasters and a serving board get used right away. The Split Letter Monogram Coasters or the Laurel Wreath Family Name Coasters protect a new coffee table, and the Circle Monogram Board and Coaster Gift Set covers the kitchen and the living room in one order. For a parent sending something to a grown child who just bought, the Welcome Home Key Monogram Board puts their initial in the bow of a skeleton key.
If you are not sure of the move-in date, the year alone is enough. Ship to the new address only after they have the keys; otherwise send it to your own address and hand it over.

faqs.q: What is a good first home gift for a couple?
faqs.a: The New Home, New Adventures Key Cutting Board, with two skeleton keys and both names, or a family name board with the year they bought.

faqs.q: Should I send the gift to their new address?
faqs.a: Only once they have moved in. Until then, ship it to yourself or to a family member who will see them.

faqs.q: What do new homeowners actually use?
faqs.a: Things for the kitchen and living room they do not have yet. Coasters and a serving board get used at the first dinner in the house.

recipient:grandparents.meta: Personalized gifts for grandparents: family name ornaments, recipe boards and grandma's house designs, laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized gifts for grandparents are engraved ornaments, recipe boards and family boards that carry the grandkids' names, the family recipe or a line about Grandma and Grandpa's house. Every piece is engraved to order in our Pryor, Oklahoma shop and ships in 3-5 business days.

It's Always Christmas at Grandma and Grandpa's House is the ornament grandkids give together, and the This Is Us Family Year Ornament lists everyone in the family with the year. For a grandmother who cooks, the Family Recipe Cutting Board turns one of her recipes into something that stays on the counter. The Deer Family First Christmas Ornament marks a first Christmas as a grandma, with the year.

Collect every grandchild's name and spelling from each branch of the family before you order, and list them oldest to youngest so nobody wonders why they came last. Grandparents tend to keep ornaments on the tree for years, so adding the year is worth it.

faqs.q: Can the whole family go in on one gift for grandparents?
faqs.a: Yes. One person orders and lists every name. The This Is Us ornament holds the whole family's names.

faqs.q: What is a good gift for new grandparents?
faqs.a: The Deer Family First Christmas Ornament, engraved with 'My first Christmas as' and their new title, plus the year.

faqs.q: Do you have a gift that names both grandparents?
faqs.a: Yes. It's Always Christmas at Grandma and Grandpa's House names both of them, and Dad, The Man, The Myth, The Legend works for a grandfather on his own.

combo:wedding-gifts/cutting-boards.meta: Personalized wedding cutting boards in maple or walnut, engraved with the couple's names and wedding date. Over twenty layouts, made in Pryor, OK.
intro: A personalized wedding cutting board is a solid maple or walnut board engraved with the couple's names, last name and wedding date. We laser engrave them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, and each one is ready to ship in 3-5 business days.

There are more than twenty wedding board layouts here, and they sort by how formal the couple is. For a classic look, choose the Circle Monogram Family Name Cutting Board or the Flourish Circle Last Name Board, with scroll flourishes around the name. For a modern couple, the Script Names and Year Cutting Board is a single line of first names. For a bold statement, the Bold Last Name Wedding Cutting Board sets the new last name in large capitals.

Size it by the kitchen, not the budget. A 10x14 inch board, 0.75 inch thick, is the everyday workhorse for a couple starting out; the 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick is the one they leave out on the counter. Wedding boards often come out for hosting, so a display stand to lean it against the backsplash is a useful add-on.

faqs.q: Which wedding board layout is most formal?
faqs.a: The circle monogram and flourish designs read most formal. Script names and bold last-name layouts are more relaxed.

faqs.q: What size wedding cutting board should I get?
faqs.a: For everyday use, the 10x14 inch board. For a board that stays out on the counter, the 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick.

combo:wedding-gifts/guest-books.meta: Wedding guest book signs guests sign at the reception, engraved with your names and date, in round and 3D frame styles. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A wedding guest book sign replaces the paper book with a wood sign your guests sign at the reception, engraved with your names and date. Ours are made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, with 3-5 business days to make each one.

Plan the table as much as the sign. Put it near the entrance or the bar where every guest passes, lay it flat or on an easel, and set out several pens so a line does not form. A small card that says 'Please sign our guest book' helps guests who have not seen one before. Ask someone in the wedding party to keep an eye on it and take it home at the end of the night.

Choose the style by where it will hang afterward. The 3D Last Name Guest Book Sign and the Last Name Signature Frame Guest Book are rectangular and suit the wall over a bed or a couch; the Round Wedding Signature Sign and the Round Guest Book Wall Art suit a mantel or an entryway. Aim to have the sign in hand a week or more before the wedding.

faqs.q: Where should the guest book sign go at the reception?
faqs.a: Near the entrance or the bar, somewhere every guest passes, flat on a table or on an easel.

faqs.q: Round or rectangular guest book sign: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Pick by the wall it will hang on. Rectangular frames fit over a bed or couch; round signs suit a mantel or entryway.

combo:wedding-gifts/charcuterie-boards.meta: Wedding charcuterie boards in maple or walnut, engraved with the couple's names and date near one end so there is room for food. Made in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A wedding charcuterie board is a serving board engraved with the couple's names and date, placed toward one end so there is room for food. We engrave ours in solid maple or walnut in Pryor, Oklahoma, made to order in 3-5 business days.

Newlyweds host more than they expect in the first year: the first holiday, the first family dinner, the friends who helped them move. A serving board with their names on it gets carried out for every one of those. The Mr and Mrs Last Name Board works for a couple taking one name, while the Framed Date Last Name Charcuterie Board and the Large Initial Framed Date Charcuterie Board give the wedding date its own frame.

Walnut is the more dramatic serving surface, and cheese and fruit look bright against it. If the couple already registered for a cutting board, a serving board avoids doubling up and still carries their names.

faqs.q: Is a charcuterie board a good wedding gift?
faqs.a: Yes, especially for a couple who likes to host. It gets used for parties and holidays rather than daily chopping.

faqs.q: What if they already registered for a cutting board?
faqs.a: Choose a serving board instead. The engraving sits at one end, so it reads as a serving piece rather than a second cutting board.

combo:wedding-gifts/coasters.meta: Personalized wedding coasters in maple or walnut, engraved with the couple's names and wedding date, in sets of 2 to 16. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Personalized wedding coasters are sets of maple or walnut coasters engraved with the couple's names, initial and wedding date on every piece. We make them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, in 3-5 business days, in sets of 2, 4, 8 or 16.

Coasters are the wedding gift for a guest who wants to give something personal at a smaller budget, from $16.50. They also work for a couple who registered for bigger kitchen items and would not think to ask for coasters. The Split Initial Names and Date Coasters carry the full date along the bottom, and the Circle Stamp Monogram Coasters have a round stamp look that suits a rustic or barn wedding.
A set of 4 suits a couple's living room. Order 16 if the coasters will go out at the bar or the head table during the reception first, then home with the couple afterward.

faqs.q: Can wedding coasters be used at the reception?
faqs.a: Yes. A set of 16 can sit at the head table or the bar during the reception and go home with the couple after.

faqs.q: What goes on wedding coasters?
faqs.a: First names, a last name or initial, and the wedding date. Each coaster in the set carries the same design.

combo:wedding-gifts/wine-glasses.meta: Engraved wedding wine glasses: 21 oz stemless glasses with the couple's monogram and date, or a bridesmaid's name and role. Made in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Engraved wedding wine glasses are 21 oz stemless glasses laser etched with the couple's names, last name and wedding date, or with a bridesmaid's name and role. Our Pryor, Oklahoma shop etches each one to order in 3-5 business days.

Order a pair for the toast. The Couples Circle Monogram Wine Glasses can be ordered as a set of 2, one for each spouse, and the Monogram Last Name Wedding Wine Glass puts a large initial and a framed date on the glass. The Circle Monogram Wine Glass and the Last Name Wedding Wine Glass round out the couple's options. After the wedding, the same glasses can come back out on each anniversary.

For the wedding party, the Bridesmaid Name Wine Glass gives each woman her own glass with her name and role. A stemless glass is steadier on a crowded head table than a tall stem, and nobody has to hunt for their glass after the first dance.

faqs.q: Are stemless glasses good for a wedding toast?
faqs.a: Yes. They sit low and steady on a crowded head table, and a 21 oz glass holds champagne or wine.

faqs.q: Can we order matching glasses for the whole wedding party?
faqs.a: Yes. Order the Bridesmaid Name Wine Glass once for each person, with their name and role.

combo:anniversary-gifts/cutting-boards.meta: Anniversary cutting boards in maple or walnut, engraved with your names and wedding date, from everyday sizes to a 16x24 walnut board. Made in Pryor, OK.
intro: An anniversary cutting board is a maple or walnut board engraved with your names and wedding date, given to mark the years since. Ours are laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma and ready to ship in 3-5 business days.

The Established Family Name Anniversary Board and the Established Family Name Couples Board put 'Established' and the year in a corner, so the board works as a serving piece and a date marker at once. The Diagonal Monogram Anniversary Board runs the names and date corner to corner for a more graphic look. For a milestone anniversary, a 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick is a heavier gift than the 0.75 inch everyday sizes.

If your first board came as a wedding gift, a walnut one at year five or ten makes a clear pair: the wedding board for daily chopping, the anniversary board for serving. Add a stand and conditioning oil and it is ready for the counter.

faqs.q: Should an anniversary board show the wedding date or the anniversary number?
faqs.a: The wedding date. It stays true every year, while an anniversary number is only right once.

faqs.q: Do you have a thicker board for a milestone anniversary?
faqs.a: Yes. The 12x16 inch board is 1.5 inches thick, and the 16x24 inch walnut board is the largest we make.

combo:anniversary-gifts/charcuterie-boar.meta: Anniversary charcuterie boards in maple or walnut, engraved with a couple's names and wedding date near one end. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: An anniversary charcuterie board is a maple or walnut serving board engraved with a couple's names and wedding date near one end. We make them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, engraved and shipped in 3-5 business days.

A serving board fits the way many couples celebrate an anniversary: at home, with cheese and a bottle of wine, rather than out. The Bold Initial Circle Charcuterie Board and the Filigree Last Name Charcuterie Board are the dressier designs. The Circle Stamp Monogram Serving Board keeps the engraving small and near the edge, so most of the wood stays open.

For a gift from grown children to their parents on a big anniversary, the 16x24 inch walnut board carries a spread for the whole family at the party. Pair the board with two engraved stemless glasses for a complete anniversary night in.

faqs.q: Is a charcuterie board a good anniversary gift for parents?
faqs.a: Yes, especially for a milestone year. A large walnut serving board with their names and wedding date gets used at the anniversary party itself.

faqs.q: Which serving board design leaves the most open space?
faqs.a: The Circle Stamp Monogram Serving Board. Its round monogram is small and set near the end of the board.

combo:anniversary-gifts/coasters.meta: Personalized anniversary coasters in maple or walnut with your names and wedding date, a lighter wood gift than a board. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Anniversary coasters are engraved maple or walnut coasters carrying a couple's names and wedding date, sold in sets of 2, 4, 8 or 16. We make each set to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

Coasters suit an anniversary that calls for something smaller: the first or second year, or a gift from a friend rather than a spouse. The Circle Monogram Anniversary Coasters stack as a set with the date on every one, and the Initial and Last Name Coasters put a framed date in the middle of each square. Wood coasters also fit the 5th, the traditional wood anniversary, at a lighter price than a board.
If the couple already has one of our monogram boards, order coasters in the same design and wood so the pieces match. Walnut coasters on a light table, or maple on a dark one, give the most contrast.

faqs.q: Can I match coasters to a board I bought before?
faqs.a: Yes. Order the same design and the same wood, with the same names and date, so the coasters match the board.

faqs.q: Are coasters enough for a 5th anniversary?
faqs.a: They are wood, so they fit the traditional 5th-anniversary theme. A set of 4 or 8 feels more complete than a pair.

combo:anniversary-gifts/wine-glasses.meta: Engraved anniversary wine glasses: 21 oz stemless glasses with your names, monogram and wedding date for the anniversary toast. Made in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Anniversary wine glasses are 21 oz stemless glasses engraved with your names, monogram and wedding date, meant for the anniversary toast. We laser engrave each glass to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

Four designs cover this: the Couples Circle Monogram Wine Glasses, which can be ordered as a set of 2; the Circle Monogram Wine Glass; the Monogram Last Name Wedding Wine Glass; and the Last Name Wedding Wine Glass. All four carry the wedding date, so a glass from your wedding year still makes sense on your fifteenth.

A glass alone is a modest gift. For an anniversary dinner at home, pair two glasses with a serving board in the same monogram. If you are replacing a wedding glass that broke, order the same design with the same names and date, and the new one will sit alongside the survivor.

faqs.q: Can I replace a wedding glass that broke?
faqs.a: Yes. Order the same design with the same names and wedding date so it matches the one you have left.

faqs.q: Do anniversary glasses come as a pair?
faqs.a: The Couples Circle Monogram Wine Glasses can be ordered as a set of 2. The other designs come single or in sets of 2, 4 or 8.

combo:housewarming-gifts/cutting-boards.meta: Housewarming cutting boards engraved with names, year, address or home state. Pick a design by what you know about the house. Made in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A housewarming cutting board is a maple or walnut board engraved for a new home, with the owners' names, the year, and often the address, state or a welcome-home line. Ours are made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma and leave the shop in 3-5 business days.

Pick the design by what you know. If you know the street address, the Welcome Home Address Cutting Board puts it under their names. If they moved across state lines, the Home State Names Cutting Board puts the new state where the O in HOME would be. If you only know their names, the Home Sweet Home Names Cutting Board or the Split Letter Last Name Board works without any house details.

The 10x14 inch board is a good default for a housewarming: large enough to use every day and easy to wrap. If they closed in December and moved in January, use the move-in year, since that is the one they will remember.

faqs.q: Which housewarming board works if I don't know the address?
faqs.a: The Home Sweet Home Names Cutting Board needs only names and a year.

faqs.q: Can the state design show any state?
faqs.a: Yes. The Home State Names Cutting Board uses whichever state you choose in place of the O.

combo:housewarming-gifts/charcuterie-boa.meta: Housewarming charcuterie boards engraved with the new homeowners' names or family name, ready for the first party. Made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A housewarming charcuterie board is a serving board engraved with the new homeowners' names or family name, ready for the first party in the house. We engrave them in maple or walnut in Pryor, Oklahoma, made to order in 3-5 business days.

Consider bringing it to the housewarming party with food already on it. A board that shows up carrying cheese, crackers and fruit gets used that night, and the engraving at one end stays visible beside the spread. The Established Family Name Charcuterie Board and the Names and Date Serving Tray are laid out this way, and the New Home Key Serving Board adds a pair of skeleton keys.

For a family that entertains, the 12x16 inch board at 1.5 inches thick is steadier to carry when loaded. If you would rather they unwrap it later, bring it wrapped and let the hosts open it after the guests leave.

faqs.q: Can I bring the board with food on it?
faqs.a: Yes. Hosts often appreciate a gift they can put out right away, and our serving designs leave open wood for the spread.

faqs.q: Which serving board mentions the new home?
faqs.a: The New Home Key Serving Board carries 'new home, new adventures, new memories' with two skeleton keys. The others focus on names and dates.

combo:housewarming-gifts/coasters.meta: Personalized housewarming coasters with a family name, monogram or home state, to protect new furniture. Maple or walnut, made to order in Pryor, OK.
intro: Housewarming coasters are maple or walnut coaster sets engraved with a family name, monogram or home state, given to protect new furniture from day one. Choose a set of 2, 4, 8 or 16; each set is engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma and ships in 3-5 business days.

A new home usually means a new coffee table or side tables that nobody wants rings on. The Home State Names Coasters put 'HOME' with the state as the O, which suits someone who just moved to a new state. The Laurel Wreath Family Name Coasters read 'The [Last Name]s' with a year, and the Split Letter Monogram Coasters are the simplest of the group.
Coasters are an easy gift to bring to a housewarming party if you do not know the hosts well. If you do, add a matching small or medium board to the order for a kitchen-and-living-room pair.

faqs.q: How many coasters should I get for a new home?
faqs.a: Four covers a living room. Eight covers a living room and a kitchen table, or a household that hosts often.

faqs.q: Are coasters a good housewarming gift for someone I don't know well?
faqs.a: Yes. They are useful, modest in price at from $16.50, and personal without being too personal.

combo:christmas-gifts/ornaments.meta: Personalized Christmas ornaments with names and the year: first Christmas, family, pet and logo designs, laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our personalized Christmas ornaments are laser engraved wood ornaments with names, a year or a logo, made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days. Each can be ordered alone or in a set of 2, 5 or 10.

Some families add one dated ornament every year, and ours are made for that habit. Our First Christmas Together, the Deer Family First Christmas Ornament and the This Is Us Family Names Ornament all record who was in the family that December. The Pet Paw Name Ornament puts the dog or cat on the tree too.

For a gift list, the Custom Logo Ornament in a set of 10 covers a small client list, and a set of 5 of It's Always Christmas at Grandma and Grandpa's House gives one to each grandchild's household. Hang them where the engraving faces out, since wood ornaments can turn on the branch.

faqs.q: Can I add the year to a Christmas ornament?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Christmas designs include the year, so each one records a specific Christmas.

faqs.q: Do you make a pet ornament?
faqs.a: Yes. The Pet Paw Name Ornament is shaped like a paw with your pet's name in the pad.

combo:christmas-gifts/wine-glasses.meta: Funny Christmas wine glasses for hostess gifts, white elephant swaps and teachers, plus monogram pairs for couples. Engraved in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our Christmas wine glasses are 21 oz stemless glasses engraved with a holiday saying or a couple's monogram. We laser engrave them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

Festive AF, in both its holiday and Christmas versions, is the office-party and white-elephant pick. Will Wrap for Wine, with little presents and stars, is for whoever does the family's gift wrapping. I Teach Little Humans is a teacher gift that is clearly not for the classroom. For a couple, the Couples Circle Monogram Wine Glasses make a pair to open on Christmas Eve.

Glasses make good hostess gifts because they are light and easy to carry to a party. For a white-elephant exchange, check the group's spending limit first; a single glass starts from $15.81, and a set of 2 fits a couple's swap.

faqs.q: Are these good for a white elephant gift exchange?
faqs.a: Yes. A funny glass is inexpensive and gets a laugh when it is opened. Festive AF fits that crowd.

faqs.q: Is Festive AF appropriate for work?
faqs.a: It depends on your office. 'AF' stands in for strong language, so save it for a crowd you know.

combo:family-keepsakes/cutting-boards.h1: Family Recipe and Name Cutting Boards
combo:family-keepsakes/cutting-boards.meta: Family recipe cutting boards, birth flower boards for mom and family name boards in maple or walnut, laser engraved to order in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A family recipe cutting board is a maple or walnut board engraved with a recipe, a family name or each child's birth flower. We make them to order in Pryor, Oklahoma, with 3-5 business days to engrave and ship.

Three boards live here. The Family Recipe Cutting Board engraves a recipe with a title and a sign-off in script. The Mom's Kitchen Birth Flower Board reads 'Everything is better in Mom's Kitchen' with a birth flower, name and year for each child. The Script Names and Year Cutting Board is the plainest of the three, two first names in one line of script with a small 'est.' year.

A recipe board often ends up as a display piece near the stove, on a stand, while a names board can take daily use. If the recipe has sentimental value, photograph the original card before you type it so nothing gets lost in transcription. Hand wash either one and oil it when the wood looks dry.

faqs.q: Should I cut on a recipe board or display it?
faqs.a: Either works. Displaying it on a stand keeps the recipe easy to read and away from knife marks.

faqs.q: Whose recipe should go on the board?
faqs.a: The one the family asks for most, written the way the person who made it wrote it.

combo:family-keepsakes/ornaments.meta: Family Christmas ornaments engraved with every family member's name, a new title like grandma, or Grandma and Grandpa's house. Made in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: Our family ornaments are laser engraved wood ornaments that list a family's names, mark a new family title or name the grandparents' house. Each is made to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

There are two versions of This Is Us, each with the year and the family's names, so a household can pick the layout it likes. The Deer Family First Christmas Ornament shows a doe and fawn with a heart for a first Christmas as a mom, grandma or aunt. It's Always Christmas at Grandma and Grandpa's House is for the grandparents who host every year.

Order one each December with the current names and you build a record of the family on the tree: a new baby, a new spouse, a new pet. Sets of 2 or 5 let each grown child's household hang the same ornament.

faqs.q: Can I order the same family ornament for each of my kids' households?
faqs.a: Yes. Order a set of 2 or 5 with the same names so every household hangs a matching ornament.

faqs.q: Should I order a new family ornament each year?
faqs.a: It is a good habit. Updating the names and year each December turns the ornaments into a record of how the family grew.

combo:family-keepsakes/guest-books.meta: Family name signature signs for weddings, vow renewals and reunions, engraved with your last name and year and hung at home. Made in Pryor, Oklahoma.
intro: A family name signature sign is a wood sign engraved with your last name and year, signed by the people who matter to you and hung at home. We make ours to order in Pryor, Oklahoma in 3-5 business days.

These start as wedding guest books, but the round last-name sign also works for a vow renewal, a milestone anniversary party or a family reunion, anywhere a crowd can sign one piece. The Round Family Name Guest Book and the Round Guest Book Sign put your last name in script in the center; the Last Name Signature Frame Guest Book is the rectangular 3D version, shown hanging over a bed.

For a reunion, pick the size by headcount the same way a couple would for a wedding, and use the reunion year instead of a wedding date. Painted white is the brightest background for signatures; stained and natural finishes show a dark marker well.

faqs.q: Can I use a guest book sign for a family reunion?
faqs.a: Yes. Put the family name and the reunion year on it, and size it to the number of people attending.

faqs.q: Which finish shows signatures best?
faqs.a: Painted white gives the most contrast for dark pens. Natural and stained finishes show a fine black marker well too.
